   - **Aggregate helpers**: [`windowSum`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L296), [`windowAvg`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L301), [`windowMin`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L306), [`windowMax`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L313), [`windowCount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L320) (emits `count(*)` when called without arguments).
   - **Frame constructors & boundaries**: [`rows`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L78), [`range`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L83), [`unboundedPreceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L26), [`currentRow`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L27), [`unboundedFollowing`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L28), [`preceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L30), [`following`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-s8y00xso/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L37).

   - **Validation & Constraints**:
     - Numeric positional arguments emit literal values (`sql.raw`) rather than bound query parameters.
     - `ntile` and `nthValue` reject non-positive integer arguments referencing function name and value.
